strengths_deep_dive: Afghan Refugee Relief delivers immediate physical support to resettled families, providing essential household setup and technological tools. According to internal reports, efforts resulted in <cite id="2">furnishing 200 homes</cite>, <cite id="2">distributing 750 laptops</cite>, and providing <cite id="2">$85,000 in financial aid</cite>. These direct services are achieved at a low unit cost of <cite id="2">$5.34 per beneficiary</cite>.
rich_narrative.summary: Afghan Refugee Relief presents significant operational limitations, primary among which is a low allocation of spending toward direct programming. In FY2024, the charity generated <cite id="5">Total Revenue of $205,225</cite>, but directed a <cite id="5">Program expense ratio of 28.9%</cite> to its direct service activities. This leaves over 70% of organizational spending absorbed by administrative and fundraising activities, falling far below the <cite id="1">75% industry standard</cite> and the <cite id="1">peer program ratio median of 89.2%</cite> for humanitarian organizations. Despite financial spending constraints, the organization provides direct support to incoming refugee families through services including <cite id="2">furnishing 200 homes</cite> and <cite id="2">distributing 750 laptops</cite>. The charity achieves a reported direct service cost of <cite id="2">$5.34 per beneficiary</cite> across its assistance operations. However, transparency and public evidence remain minimal, with no independent third-party impact evaluations available and limited public financial disclosures. Donors looking to support general refugee aid can contribute through <cite id="3">sadaqah and general charitable giving</cite>.
